headline: Sensex nears 82,000 and Nifty hits 8-month high amid foreign inflows and strong Q2 earnings

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Optimism over foreign portfolio investment (FPI) inflows into Indian equities
Decline in global oil prices boosting sentiment across sectors
Moody's hiking India's FY27 GDP growth estimate to 7% based on investment and consumption
Strong Q2 financial results from major companies like Tata Power and Hindustan Copper
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,300 points to approach the 82,000 mark
Nifty 50 crossed the 25,350 level, reaching its highest point in eight months
Financial and auto stocks led the market gains during the rally
Approximately ₹35 lakh crore was added to market capitalization over the last seven sessions
summary: Indian benchmarks Sensex and Nifty rallied significantly, driven by robust foreign fund inflows and a drop in global crude oil prices. Major companies like Tata Power and Hindustan Copper reported strong Q2 profit growth, further boosting investor confidence. Moody's also upgraded India's GDP growth forecast, reflecting positive domestic economic dynamics.
